## Change

What problem does this solve, and what should a reviewer observe afterwards?

## Verification

State which checks you ran and any known limitations. Include before/after
screenshots for visible changes and update the relevant guide when paths or
commands change.

## Trust and data flows

If this changes identity, client isolation, evidence handling, trust, or outbound
data flows, describe the affected boundary and the test that covers it. Otherwise,
write “No change.”
